requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-4452-5291--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Rukarumel, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Cursed Mirror. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Rukarumel, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

574-1445-4871-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
574-1445-4871-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
574-1445-4871-8347.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1445-2267-4871-8249.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-4871-8249.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-3075-8164.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters
1170-3075-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

3532-4928-5078-8176.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4928-5078-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4474-4687-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least three charge counters on it.
4474-4687-5479.description:
Activate Paradise Mantle by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte two times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping two lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-5007-6972.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

222-527-1849-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1849-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

222-527-728-1849.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1170-3446-5131-5315--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3446-5131-5315--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

1477-2111-6792.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

3617-7370-7874.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling The Immortal Weapons.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning The Immortal Weapons from exile to the battlefield.
When The Immortal Weapons enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3007-3899-4552-7803.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-3007-3899-4552-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
539-3007-3899-4552-7803.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-4890.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dack's Duplicate and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1778-3661-6516-7039.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-3661-6516-7039.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

183-1778-3652-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
183-1778-3652-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1379-5641-6830-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-5641-6830-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2946-4871-5686-6887.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5686-6887.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3334-4762-6774.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Loading Zone and Lae'zel.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

3755-5864-7109.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four in any combination of Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats that don't have summoning sickness.
3755-5864-7109.description:
Activate any number of Birds, Frogs, Otters and/or Rats by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Frogs, Otters and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to a Bird, Frog, Otter or Rat.
Activate the creature by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3703-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5147-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5147-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5147-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet

1974-2228-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Quicksilver Gargantuan.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Quicksilver Gargantuan by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

826-1399-1606-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
826-1399-1606-6071.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and The Core.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

2665-2743-6753.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

4484-4871-5256-5643-6556.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-5256-5643-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
4484-4871-5256-5643-6556.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5256-5643-6556.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2743-3853-6570.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Mirage Mockery and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Mirage Mockery copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

6323-6329.easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.
6323-6329.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Chastise by paying {3}{W}, destroying Jumbo Cactuar and causing you to gain 10,000 life.

3057-3487-4636-6320.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}
3057-3487-4636-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Bloodthirster that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
When the Bloodthirster token enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Aetherstorm Roc trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Bloodthirster token. The token triggers, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3443-3995-6287.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least six creature cards in your graveyard.
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness.
Horseshoe Crab and Deathbloom Ritualist are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
3443-3995-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Deathbloom Ritualist.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Horseshoe Crab.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2781-4050-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Felidar Guardian.
2781-4050-6132.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-4871-5695-5752.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Brokkos.
When Brokkos dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio four times by sacrificing four Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio abilities, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U/B}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate cost by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling.
Repeat from step 3.

654-774-5621.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Arid Archway.
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1445-1753-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1753-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

369-4050-4775.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-4050-4775.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Iridescent Drake, adding one mana of any color.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Repeat.

317-1475-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

147-313-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-313-2034.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

915-4222-5116.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Synod Artificer.
Synod Artificer does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to blue is at least three.
915-4222-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat.

2060-3726-4772-4929.description:
Activate Shalai by paying {4}{G}{G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

225-539-907-1257.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Walking Atlas as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

306-2556-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying {4}{U}.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your next upkeep on your extra turn, Cache Raiders triggers, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
